title: Sources: US officials believe Jensen Huang had a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, who they allege was recruited to spy for China's top spy agency, MSS (Demetri Sevastopulo/Financial Times)
summary: Demetri Sevastopulo / Financial Times: Sources: US officials believe Jensen Huang had a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, who they allege was recruited to spy for China's top spy agency, MSS — American intelligence warned the tech boss was involved with executive recruited by China to gather information on US group
